Privacy Policy

Draft -- placeholder text, not yet reviewed by a lawyer. Replace before taking real orders.

What we collect. Name, email, shipping address, and phone number, entered at checkout, used only to ship your NodeCard and email you about your order.

Payment. Card details are entered directly on Stripe's own payment page and never touch NodeCard's servers -- we only ever see that a payment succeeded, not your card number.

What we don't do. We don't sell your information, and we don't share it with anyone except Stripe (to process payment) and our shipping carrier (to deliver your order).

Tutoring-center decks. If you subscribe to a vocabulary list from a tutoring center, your email is shared with that center only to manage your subscription.

Questions or data requests. Contact us to see, correct, or delete the information we have about you.
